servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read, write and search files in directories you explicitly allow. Useful for letting an assistant work inside a project folder.

env.name: ALLOWED_DIR
env.description: Absolute path the server is permitted to access. Keep it as narrow as possible.

servers.name: Git
servers.description: Inspect history, diffs and branches, and stage changes without leaving the conversation.

env.name: REPO_PATH
env.description: Path to the local git repository the server operates on.

servers.name: Fetch
servers.description: Retrieve a web page and convert it to clean markdown, so an assistant can answer from live pages instead of guessing.

servers.name: Memory
servers.description: A knowledge graph the assistant can write to and recall from, so preferences survive across sessions.

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Web search with ranked results and snippets, for questions that need current information.

env.name: BRAVE_API_KEY
env.description: API key from brave.com/search/api. Stored locally, never in the catalog.

servers.name: Everything (reference)
servers.description: Reference server exposing every MCP tool type, useful for testing an MCP client end to end.
servers.notes: Demo/reference server. Curated because it is the canonical way to verify a client works.

servers.name: Time
servers.description: Current time and timezone conversion, so scheduling questions resolve against a real clock.
